DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) Retinitis

Given your history of AIDS, the sudden onset of vision loss and black spots (floaters) in one eye is highly suggestive of CMV retinitis. I need to confirm if you have any systemic symptoms like fever or night sweats, and I will request a dilated fundus examination images to visualize the retina.
